description: The Spektaretta is a camera that makes colour images by a colour-separation method: the image from the lens is split into three by a system of prisms, to make three simultaneous exposures (24×24 mm) through red, green and blue filters, onto monochrome 35 mm film.[https://web.archive.org/web/20210411
